$comment: The behavioural coverage inventory: every user-facing schema path and closed branch of the audited schemas plus TASK-207 and the recording commands of TASK-381, the scenarios that exercise it, what correct use is, and who owns the evidence. author-run: a model run proves it (graded by the blinded grader against source); harness-check: the deterministic outcome checks prove it from the saved board; grader: only the grader can judge it; runtime-owner: an existing fast test owns it and no model run is asked to. An entry with no scenarios is uncovered by model runs and says so.

entries.path: board.name, board.level (configured)
entries.expectedUse: one board named as asked at the configured level

entries.path: create.variant, create.summary (initial variant name/summary)
entries.expectedUse: fixtures name the initial variant; an author may
entries.owner: variant-exists on the fixture-named variant; packages/board/tests/runtime

entries.path: empty board then population
entries.expectedUse: a board may start empty and be filled by edits
entries.owner: packages/board/tests/runtime (create with empty content, then edit)

entries.path: edit.level (board-level level change)
entries.expectedUse: level moves with the board, not a variant

entries.expectedUse: configured kind, clear short responsibility grounded in source and readable over two or three rendered lines when useful; optional explicit newlines; longer detail in description
entries.owner: grader feature node.kind, node.responsibility; harness node-kind
